subject: math
description: Use indirect measurement with shadows, mirrors, and scale drawings to solve real-world similarity problems.
learningObjectives: Identify similar triangles formed by shadows, mirrors, or scale drawings
Set up and solve proportions for indirect measurement
Use mirror sightlines to relate eye height, mirror distance, and object height
Convert units before comparing corresponding lengths
Interpret scale drawings to estimate real distances and heights
Check whether a real-world similarity answer is reasonable
prerequisites: Recognize corresponding sides in similar triangles
Convert common metric and customary units
